verdict.rationale: Evidence shows official REST API reference docs, an llms.txt that references installing Stripe npm packages (implying official SDKs), plus an official CLI and MCP server for programmatic/agentic access, but there is no explicit documentation pack for language-specific SDKs (stripe-node, stripe-python, etc.), version/changelog info, or hands-on developer confirmation of SDK ergonomics for Issuing specifically. missing for 10: explicit multi-language SDK docs/repos, SDK versioning/changelog evidence, independent developer corroboration of SDK usability for Issuing.
